criteria.evidence: Exact alignment across all identifiers: DOCX ID 0138, official requirement I19-E28, project 157 index 152. Exact official wording preserved from printed page 9: 「個人績效提升（薪資提升或獎勵升遷之紀錄）。」 Official checkbox sequence is explicitly kept distinct as UNKNOWN and not conflated with DOCX ID or index 152.

Title-blind evaluation verifies that the core structure consists of individual case handling, purpose-limited consent/basis, third-party source intake and locator tracking, exact claim-to-source matrix, separated salary/reward/promotion fields, independent issuer verification, and second-person review. It is an individual third-party verification record, not an aggregate salary survey or media clipping.

Defines 4 concrete functional responsibilities (R-01 Intake, R-02 Verification, R-03 Custody, R-04 Independent Review) and a 7-stage operational workflow (Stages 0 to 6) with explicit gate criteria and stop/HOLD rules. Independent review (R-04) cannot be performed by the claim compiler.

Complete consent and choice framework: specifies purpose limitation to I19-E28 verification, minimal data fields, recipients, retention basis, withdrawal handling, and stop conditions (HOLD_PRIVACY). Refers to PDPA Articles 11 and 19 without offering legal advice or asserting fixed statutory duration.

Third-party source intake form and index capture issuer, document class/ID, effective date, page/field, acquisition channel/time, independent issuer check channel, controlled location, document version identification, and access category. Explicitly establishes that document-provided contact details alone do not authenticate, and version tracking does not prove content truth.

Claim-to-source mapping for salary (CLM-01), promotion (CLM-02), and reward (CLM-03). Salary comparison requires identical currency, period, wage components, and contracted working time/FTE comparability; zero or missing denominators map to N/A. Rewards and promotions strictly limited to source-documented scope.

Recalculated linked sample SYN-0126-01: baseline NT$32,000 to followup NT$33,000 = +NT$1,000 difference; rate (33,000-32,000)/32,000 * 100 = 3.1250%, displayed as 3.13%. Anomaly drill SYN-0138-EX-01 recalculates overtime exclusion (gross 35,500 with 2,500 OT -> 33,000 comparable base = 3.13% vs unadjusted 10.94%). Both strictly registered as synthetic demonstration values.

Strict boundary between SAMPLE and REAL maintained throughout. REAL evidence is consistently UNKNOWN / HOLD, formal acceptance NOT_GRANTED. No fabricated employer originals, signatures, issuer replies, mock payroll slips, or association approvals. Training causation is explicitly disclaimed.

Explicitly differentiates and rejects substitution from nearest negative neighbors: 0137/I19-E27 (media reporting), 0139/I19-E29 (aggregate license/employment rate), 0126/I19-E14 (cohort salary survey), and 0125/I19-E13 (job skill application). None can substitute for individual compensation records.

Usable operational toolkit for training administrators: 10-point checklist with failure paths, discrepancy log with synthetic drill, 8 decision states, unsent verification letter draft (DRAFT/NOT SENT), blank REAL capture template (16.1-16.4), and 9-point pre-use approval checklist.

Bidirectional traceability from official requirement clauses to document sections/fields (Table 18) and comprehensive 10-item synthetic replacement register REG-01 through REG-10 (Table 20) documenting every synthetic element, required real input, and completion criteria.

limitations: Semantic transcription review only; visual layout, typography, and page rendering were not inspected as part of this review and are governed separately by the visual receipt.

Formal acceptance is NOT_GRANTED; candidate status only pending formal association review and system deployment.

criteria.evidence: Exact alignment across all identifiers: DOCX ID 0138, official requirement I19-E28, project 157 index 152. Exact official wording preserved from printed page 9: 「個人績效提升（薪資提升或獎勵升遷之紀錄）。」 Official checkbox sequence is explicitly kept distinct as UNKNOWN and not conflated with DOCX ID or index 152.

Title-blind evaluation verifies that the core structure consists of individual case handling, purpose-limited consent/basis, third-party source intake and locator tracking, exact claim-to-source matrix, separated salary/reward/promotion fields, independent issuer verification, and second-person review. It is an individual third-party verification record, not an aggregate salary survey or media clipping.

Defines 4 concrete functional responsibilities (R-01 Intake, R-02 Verification, R-03 Custody, R-04 Independent Review) and a 7-stage operational workflow (Stages 0 to 6) with explicit gate criteria and stop/HOLD rules. Independent review (R-04) cannot be performed by the claim compiler.

Complete consent and choice framework: specifies purpose limitation to I19-E28 verification, minimal data fields, recipients, retention basis, withdrawal handling, and stop conditions (HOLD_PRIVACY). Refers to PDPA Articles 11 and 19 without offering legal advice or asserting fixed statutory duration.

Third-party source intake form and index capture issuer, document class/ID, effective date, page/field, acquisition channel/time, independent issuer check channel, controlled location, document version identification, and access category. Explicitly establishes that document-provided contact details alone do not authenticate, and version tracking does not prove content truth.

Claim-to-source mapping for salary (CLM-01), promotion (CLM-02), and reward (CLM-03). Salary comparison requires identical currency, period, wage components, and contracted working time/FTE comparability; zero or missing denominators map to N/A. Rewards and promotions strictly limited to source-documented scope.

Recalculated linked sample SYN-0126-01: baseline NT$32,000 to followup NT$33,000 = +NT$1,000 difference; rate (33,000-32,000)/32,000 * 100 = 3.1250%, displayed as 3.13%. Anomaly drill SYN-0138-EX-01 recalculates overtime exclusion (gross 35,500 with 2,500 OT -> 33,000 comparable base = 3.13% vs unadjusted 10.94%). Both strictly registered as synthetic demonstration values.

Strict boundary between SAMPLE and REAL maintained throughout. REAL evidence is consistently UNKNOWN / HOLD, formal acceptance NOT_GRANTED. No fabricated employer originals, signatures, issuer replies, mock payroll slips, or association approvals. Training causation is explicitly disclaimed.

Explicitly differentiates and rejects substitution from nearest negative neighbors: 0137/I19-E27 (media reporting), 0139/I19-E29 (aggregate license/employment rate), 0126/I19-E14 (cohort salary survey), and 0125/I19-E13 (job skill application). None can substitute for individual compensation records.

Usable operational toolkit for training administrators: 10-point checklist with failure paths, discrepancy log with synthetic drill, 8 decision states, unsent verification letter draft (DRAFT/NOT SENT), blank REAL capture template (16.1-16.4), and 9-point pre-use approval checklist.

Bidirectional traceability from official requirement clauses to document sections/fields (Table 18) and comprehensive 10-item synthetic replacement register REG-01 through REG-10 (Table 20) documenting every synthetic element, required real input, and completion criteria.

limitations: Semantic transcription review only; visual layout, typography, and page rendering were not inspected as part of this review and are governed separately by the visual receipt.
REAL evidence status remains UNKNOWN / HOLD; candidate contains no authentic third-party originals, consent signatures, or employer responses.
Formal acceptance is NOT_GRANTED; candidate status only pending formal association review and system deployment.

negative_neighbors.0126_I19-E14: Cohort post-training salary survey and statistical analysis; aggregate survey cannot substitute for individual third-party primary evidence.
negative_neighbors.0137_I19-E27: Media interview and report verification; external reporting cannot verify individual employment compensation or personnel changes.
negative_neighbors.0139_I19-E29: Aggregate license passing rate and employment rate improvement report; group rates cannot prove an individual's compensation record.
